mg-0dG7.title: Coverage: yellow tank top and blue T-shirt pair
mg-0dG7.summary: Two coverage pieces show two people following: one in a yellow tank top and one in a blue T-shirt. The first piece is in the town of St Augustin.

mg-2sOi.title: Coverage: same two people in hilly shrubland
mg-2sOi.summary: The second piece with the yellow-tank-top and blue-shirt pair runs east of St Augustin through hilly land with many shrubs.

mg-3Ucb.title: Coverage: person in dark blue T-shirt
mg-3Ucb.summary: A person in a dark blue T-shirt and black sunglasses points to the town of Ambanja in the north.

mg-4v0Z.title: Google car: faint grey roof rack
mg-4v0Z.summary: A car with a barely visible grey metal roof rack, near a southwest village. Sometimes the car is fully blurred, and the blur shape is your best hint.

mg-61Nb.title: Coverage: village with the shore to the east
mg-61Nb.summary: A village with the sea to the east, north of the southwest town of Andavadoaka.

mg-6Icy.title: Coverage: tiny sand-only atoll
mg-6Icy.summary: On the central west coast, the northernmost atoll is the smallest. It is only sand, and you can always see from one shore to the other. Only the two southernmost of five atolls appear on the map.

mg-6fjx.title: Boat: mainly blue
mg-6fjx.summary: A mostly blue boat runs along the coast south of the northwest island.

mg-7g5M.title: Boat: big sail, yellow and blue bow
mg-7g5M.summary: A boat with a large sail nearly filling the screen and a yellow-and-blue painted bow. The sail is missing in the northern parts. This is north of Andavadoaka.

mg-8CI7.title: Coverage: hillside overlooking a city
mg-8CI7.summary: Most of the capital's coverage is on a hillside looking out over the city, with the Queen's Palace near the top.

mg-8VEn.title: Coverage: many palms, brown sandy road
mg-8VEn.summary: Lots of palms and a brown, sandy dirt road, usually with a person in front in a grey T-shirt and brown backpack. This is the Ambiky area in the northwest.

mg-8VYx.title: Coverage: grey hat with light blue shirt
mg-8VYx.summary: Most backpack coverage around Andavadoaka shows either a person in a greyish hat and light blue shirt, or a person in a yellow T-shirt.

mg-8jw5.title: Coverage: beach with low trees and low mountains
mg-8jw5.summary: A beach with low trees and low mountains to the northwest, just west of the Ambiky area.

mg-AmoS.title: Google car: big silver roof rack, dry sand
mg-AmoS.summary: A Street View car with a large silver roof rack in very dry, sandy surroundings, on the RN8 road between two inland towns.

mg-D7s5.title: Coverage: smooth sand beach, lots of palms
mg-D7s5.summary: A very smooth sandy beach with the ocean to the northwest and many palms. This is at the west coast town of Morondava.

mg-FAEV.title: Coverage: bald person in striped shirt
mg-FAEV.summary: A bald person in a light green or light red striped shirt, on one of the few paved roads walked by the backpack. This is the west coast town of Morondava.

mg-FYx3.title: Boat: four people in red, blue, yellow and brown
mg-FYx3.summary: Four people on a boat: red, blue and yellow at the back and brown at the front, near the town of St Augustin.

mg-Gu8N.title: Coverage: seaside village with almost no people
mg-Gu8N.summary: A small seaside village with few or no people, at the northern end of the bay south of Andavadoaka.

mg-IywX.title: Coverage: person in light blue T-shirt
mg-IywX.summary: A second backpack route going northeast of Andavadoaka shows a person in a light blue T-shirt.

mg-JKHg.title: Coverage: many palms on white sand
mg-JKHg.summary: Lots of palms over a blanket of white sand points to the village of Belo Sur Mer.

mg-KdDD.title: Vegetation: avenue of very thick-trunked baobabs
mg-KdDD.summary: A road lined with baobab trees with extremely wide trunks. This is the famous Baobab Avenue.

mg-Kgz7.title: Coverage: very dry, four people in red, blue
mg-Kgz7.summary: A backpack walk next to the RN8, very dry, with four people wearing red, blue, grey and light blue.

mg-M3tI.title: Coverage: cluster of fishing nets in a bay
mg-M3tI.summary: A cluster of fishing nets can be seen in the bay.

mg-MGm7.title: Coverage: sandy village on a cape
mg-MGm7.summary: A small, very sandy village with the sea to the north, on a small cape north of Andavadoaka. Some of it is shot just off the shoreline.

mg-Ma9o.title: Coverage: red T-shirt with white cap
mg-Ma9o.summary: A small stretch along the river has two different people: one in a red T-shirt and white cap, one in a spotted dress.

mg-NzF4.title: Coverage: three people in grey hat
mg-NzF4.summary: Three people appear: one in a greyish hat and light blue shirt, and two in red and white T-shirts. This is the town of Andavadoaka.

mg-QWtV.title: Coverage: dirty-sand beach, curved shore
mg-QWtV.summary: A beach with somewhat dirty sand and a curved shoreline, with the ocean to the northwest. This is outside Belo Sur Mer.

mg-Sm22.title: Landscape: small settlement
mg-Sm22.summary: A small settlement at the northeast end of the mountain area, with mountains in the background.

mg-TxsK.title: Coverage: dark forest walk
mg-TxsK.summary: A small part is shot inside a forest that sometimes hides the mountains. It is fairly dark, with four people following the camera.

mg-U5fc.title: Vegetation: tiny atolls with broad-leaved palms
mg-U5fc.summary: The other atolls are very small and have broad-leaved palms, which are rare elsewhere in the country.

mg-V2nD.title: Language: French and Malagasy, long words
mg-V2nD.summary: Signs use French and Malagasy, which uses Latin letters and many long words. English appears on some shop signs.

mg-VJ9Z.title: Coverage: hilly forested island
mg-VJ9Z.summary: Very hilly, forested coverage with people in a blue T-shirt (sunglasses on the forehead), a light red T-shirt, a darker red tank top, and sometimes a light blue T-shirt. This is a small island in the northwest.

mg-Vjwp.title: Cart: white cow left, black-and-white cow right
mg-Vjwp.summary: Another cart pulled by a white cow on the left and a black-and-white cow on the right, just south of Andavadoaka.

mg-WE2E.title: Coverage: several boat trekkers
mg-WE2E.summary: Several boat-mounted cameras exist around the country, so a view from the water is a good sign.

mg-X1Fm.title: Coverage: many people, village to the west
mg-X1Fm.summary: Several people walk around the camera, with a small village to the west and a part crossing very shallow water. This is the southeastern part of the bay.

mg-YZcR.title: Cart: blue, black cow left
mg-YZcR.summary: A blue cart pulled by a black cow on the left and a brown-and-white cow on the right, south of Andavadoaka.

mg-Zrpg.title: Coverage: big lone green bushes
mg-Zrpg.summary: Large, single green bushes and a slight red tint in the soil. Parts are quite wet. This is south of the Ambiky area.

mg-bzxa.title: Landscape: huge steep rock mountain
mg-bzxa.summary: A large single rock mountain with steep sides, in a mountainous area, with four people following the camera. This is the Tsaranoro Massif.

mg-dsgX.title: Boat: smaller sail or red "Diesel" T-shirt
mg-dsgX.summary: A boat with a smaller sail than the northern one, or a person at the bow in a red T-shirt saying "Diesel". Usually only one of the two shows.

mg-hzyJ.title: Coverage: one person in dark blue shirt along
mg-hzyJ.summary: Three main sections along a river, mostly with a single person in a dark blue T-shirt and sunglasses on the forehead. The same person appears on the northwest island.

mg-iNsg.title: Boat: rowing boat, five people
mg-iNsg.summary: A row boat with five people and a wide wooden frame around it, northwest of the coastal village of Ambohimena.

mg-ih6i.title: Boat: driver in white cap, no shirt
mg-ih6i.summary: The boat covering the small central west-coast atolls has a driver wearing a white cap and no shirt.

mg-jaEx.title: Coverage: small, mostly west coast
mg-jaEx.summary: Coverage is very limited, mostly on or near the west coast, nearly all by backpack. Only two spots show a Street View car. Learn it as land coverage and boat coverage.

mg-jwVN.title: Coverage: village on a northern shore
mg-jwVN.summary: A village on the northern shore of a small northwest island.

mg-k6M6.title: Boat: river boat with tourist and gondolier
mg-k6M6.summary: A boat on a river with a tourist in a blue T-shirt and a boatman in a brown shirt. The northernmost part is very dark, shot at sunset.

mg-lIiH.title: Camera: Gen 3 backpack everywhere
mg-lIiH.summary: All coverage is shot with an older Gen 3 backpack (trekker) camera. Some odd vehicles appear, but the camera and blur stay the same.

mg-peJo.title: Climate: very dry south and centre
mg-peJo.summary: The south and centre are extremely dry, while the north is tropical and green.

mg-puA3.title: Coverage: busy town with nobody following
mg-puA3.summary: A busy-looking town and the only large town in the country with no person following the camera. This is Toliara.

mg-trNX.title: Coverage: rocky ground, nobody following
mg-trNX.summary: Somewhat rocky ground with no people following the camera, southwest of the bay.

mg-uY1o.title: Coverage: people walking beside the camera
mg-uY1o.summary: Most coverage has one or more people walking next to the camera. Use them to confirm the country and to guess the region.

mg-wCgg.title: Boat: white, many people on board
mg-wCgg.summary: A white boat carrying many people goes around the northwest island.

mg-x1Ap.title: Landscape: the reddest soil in the country
mg-x1Ap.summary: The reddest soil on Street View in Madagascar points to Kirindy Mitea National Park.

mg-xeXN.title: Coverage: grassy field and a dune side
mg-xeXN.summary: Coverage partly on a big grassy field and partly on the side of a sand dune, south of the village of Manahy.
